judge.rationale: The candidate stopped after writing the acceptance test and never modified `src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.ts`, so the newly added test will fail and the bug remains unfixed. Furthermore, its `rejectingProvider` test helper lacks an `eslint-disable-next-line require-yield` comment, which would cause ESLint to fail with `--max-warnings 0`. The candidate also failed to update `CHANGELOG.md` and left the recorded-flaw text in `specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md` instead of replacing it with the new guarantee. Finally, it committed an internal `.lore/dod.md` file and created a separate test file instead of adding to `src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.test.ts`.
